title: Same distances encoded at Roman sites
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Same distances encoded at Roman sites, about Roman period at Roman sites, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: of 5,300 m and 2300 m encoded in Roman sites as well and these hillsides that have the same configuration as the White Horse Hills of Wilshire, England.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says an alien told him the true purpose of the pyramids, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he finds the same distances, 5,300 meters and 2,300 meters, built into Roman sites. He says these places sit on hillsides laid out the same way as the White Horse hills of Wiltshire, England. If true, it would point to one shared ancient plan behind sites far apart.
